product_one_liner.value: Druid AI helps enterprises build, deploy, and govern AI agents that automate customer and employee workflows across chat, SMS, voice, and email.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes an enterprise platform for developing and deploying agents, with governed automation of customer and employee journeys across chat, SMS, voice, and email. Sources: https://www.druidai.com/platform/security and https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261014498211/en/Druid-AI-Expands-Enterprise-Agentic-AI-Platform-with-Voice-Enhancements-Agent-Interoperability-and-Governance-Capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes tailored pricing plans and the pricing model, although numerical prices require a quote: https://www.druidai.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: MatrixCare and Liberty Global appear in the company's homepage customer-logo area: https://www.druidai.com/. | named_customers.0: MatrixCare appears in the homepage customer-logo area: https://www.druidai.com/. | named_customers.1: Liberty Global appears in the homepage customer-logo area: https://www.druidai.com/.

employee_band.notes: The current hiring profile reports approximately 216 employees, and another company record reports 223; both fall within 201-500. These are third-party counts. Sources: https://jobspipe.dev/hiring/druidai.com and https://tracxn.com.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company LinkedIn profile explicitly identifies New York as headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/druidplatform. Other records retain a Romanian location, so this follows the company's stated headquarters. | hq_country: The company's LinkedIn profile identifies New York as headquarters and gives a U.S. address. This uses its stated headquarters rather than its Romanian operational origin. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/druidplatform and https://linkedin.com/company/18649492.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2018: https://www.druidai.com/about-us.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents enterprise automation insights and one technical-looking reference-model article, not two engineer-authored posts explaining how Druid itself is built. It therefore does not meet the requested engineering-blog threshold. Source: https://www.druidai.com/blog/all.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple guides, including Druid Voice, LLM Response Streaming, and Building AI Agents: https://docs.druidai.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Both the company careers page and its recruiting board list Technical Consultant, with no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science job title. Sources: https://www.druidai.com/careers and https://druidsa.bamboohr.com/careers.

model_provider.value: Druid models (Becus), with configurable connections to OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Mistral AI, AWS Bedrock, and Mesolitica/MaLLaM.
model_provider.notes: The documentation explicitly lists these configurable provider connections and separately names Druid's Becus models. This does not imply every deployment uses every provider. Sources: https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Knowledgebase/KB%20Settings/Generative%20Endpoints.htm and https://docs.druidai.com/docs/Content/Governance%20&%20Security/LLM%20Resource%20Management%20and%20Governance.htm.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security FAQ names these four standards in its compliance-alignment claims. This records publicly claimed alignment, not independently verified audited certification; the wording does not establish formal certification. PCI DSS is not included. Source: https://www.druidai.com/platform/security. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is explicitly named in the security FAQ's alignment claim, not established as an audited certification: https://www.druidai.com/platform/security. | compliance_certs.1: ISO 27001 is explicitly named in the security FAQ's alignment claim, not established as an audited certification: https://www.druidai.com/platform/security. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA is explicitly named in the company's public compliance-alignment claim: https://www.druidai.com/platform/security. | compliance_certs.3: GDPR is explicitly named in the company's public compliance-alignment claim: https://www.druidai.com/platform/security.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company announcement and latest-round record identify the financing as Series C. Sources: https://www.druidai.com/news/druid-ai-raises-31-million-series-c and https://tracxn.com. | funding_date: The announcement and funding history both date the latest round to September 16, 2025, yielding 2025-09. Sources: https://www.druidai.com/news/druid-ai-raises-31-million-series-c and https://tracxn.com. | funding_amount_usd: The company announcement reports a $31 million Series C, matching the latest round in the funding history. Sources: https://www.druidai.com/news/druid-ai-raises-31-million-series-c and https://tracxn.com.

raised_18mo.notes: The $31 million Series C announced on September 16, 2025 falls within the requested 18-month window. Source: https://www.druidai.com/news/druid-ai-raises-31-million-series-c.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Druid AI Account Executive listing shows a posting age of one week, an expiry of December 17, 2026, and an application option. Confidence is reduced because this is a third-party listing and the role is absent from the official careers board. Source: https://bebee.com/us/jobs/account-executive-druid-ai--fj-2410962862.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 14, 2026 announcement introduces substantive voice, agent-interoperability, governance, and evaluation capabilities, including Druid MCP. This falls within the requested six-month window. Sources: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261014498211/en/Druid-AI-Expands-Enterprise-Agentic-AI-Platform-with-Voice-Enhancements-Agent-Interoperability-and-Governance-Capabilities and https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/druid-ai-expands-enterprise-agentic-130000542.html.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying company join or departure could be established for the window. Leadership biographies lack appointment dates, and the dated VP of Product evidence describes an internal promotion rather than a company join. The available roster and dated history were insufficient to establish a reliable negative. Pages examined include https://www.druidai.com/stories/tag/leadership-team and https://linkedin.com/in/vlad-ionescu-darzeu-03b9b3bb.
